counting_policy.fatal_status: Delete severity=fatal and fatal_for_conservative_acceptance. The A088201 needs_status_recheck warning is excluded.
counting_policy.hard_exact_source: Delete current rows whose exact claim is not the candidate occurrence and is classified hard_candidate_provenance_mismatch. Minor punctuation-only mismatches are excluded.
counting_policy.redundancy: For each high-confidence semantic-equivalence or general/special subsumption cluster, delete every non-representative key. The partial-overlap A229452 cluster is excluded.
counting_policy.upper_bound_boundary: The survivor number is an upper bound after only these three requested deletion classes. It does not subtract the A182514 contradiction, atomicity/context warnings, normalization warnings, or duplicates against release 5.3.
